author: China Insights
description:
The chief designer of the J-20 fighter jet, Yang Wei, has been taken down. Many military engineering experts have suddenly disappeared! Three real battles have ripped apart China's defense myths: Radars go blind, missiles turn into duds. The whole military system is falling apart. The 15th Five-Year Plan is turning into a huge money pit!

China Insights delivers sharp, data-driven analysis of China’s politics, economy, and society.
We connect the dots behind breaking headlines — from Beijing’s power shifts to global market trends — helping viewers understand the real forces shaping modern China.
Stay informed. Stay ahead.
title: Military Experts Disappear; Three Real Battles Shatter China’s Defense Myths
